explanation.headline: FDA's records show no shortage signal for the WG Critical Care product at our plants; Merck Sharp & Dohme listings are marked To Be Discontinued with initial postings 2026-01-08 and 2026-09-09

sentences.text: The imipenem and cilastatin vials used at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside all carry NDC 44567-705-10 and SPL set ID 46f54df9-5afe-430c-aa19-0d84c2044b0b, identifying the labeler as WG Critical Care, LLC and the manufacturing plant as Zambon Switzerland Ltd. in Cadempino.

FDA's shortage list contains two Merck Sharp & Dohme entries for imipenem-containing products, both status To Be Discontinued, with initial posting dates 2026-01-08 and 2026-09-09, but neither references the WG Critical Care NDC or the Zambon plant.

Because the FDA has not posted a shortage signal for the WG Critical Care product manufactured at Zambon Switzerland, the current supply pressure at Corvale East reflects local demand rather than a federally tracked shortage.

Q-399f81.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%imipenem%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%imipenem%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key
